sentences.text: Jenna Dewan Tatum -LRB- -LSB- də ` wɑːn _ ` teɪtəm -RSB- born Jenna Lee Dewan ; December 3 , 1980 -RRB- is an American actress and dancer .

She began her career as a backup dancer for Janet Jackson , and later worked with artists including Pink , Missy Elliott , and Christina Aguilera .	backup dancer	backup dancer	Janet Jackson	Janet Jackson	Pink	Pink (singer)	Missy Elliott	Missy Elliott	Christina Aguilera	Christina Aguilera
She is known for her role as Nora in the 2006 film Step Up .	Step Up	Step Up (film)

She has also starred on the short-lived NBC series The Playboy Club and had a recurring role on the FX series American Horror Story : Asylum .	NBC	NBC	The Playboy Club	The Playboy Club	FX	FX (TV channel)
